about: Hello, I'm Satyam Rastogi, Senior Back-end Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable micro-services and distributed systems. onboaring process and migration from old to new systems

Currently working as SDE-2 at Booking.com in Amsterdam, Building the Offer Service — responsible for providing and validating availability, and creating a separate versioned domain structure for availability, pricing, and policy that is extendable and maintainable across the new flow.

Created partner onboarding and single form combining all the different compliance reducing onboaring time from weeks to days. for new compliance only new qusetion were asked and consent taken to fast track the process.
Previously at Flat White Capital (IndiaGold) as a Senior Software Developer, building loan origination systems, KYC integrations, and digital gold loan features.
Also worked at Pasarpolis on policy commission disbursement and policy lifecycle management using Python, Django, and Kubernetes.
Started my career at Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS) building patch automation tools on the OUAF platform.
Core expertise: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Boot Reactive, Kafka, MySQL, Amazon RDS/SQS, Micro-service architecture, Functional Programming.
Strong experience with testing tools like Wiremock and Mockito, caching strategies, and event-driven design patterns.
I'm continuously growing currently exploring reactive programming patterns and ai driven efficiency improvements for any project

experience.title: SDE - 2
description: Worked on onboarding new partners to compliance — handling validation, risk analysis, and collecting partner information required for different financial regulations.

Created partner onboarding and single form combining all the different compliance reducing onboaring time from weeks to days. for new compliance only new qusetion were asked and consent taken to fast track the process.
Team 2 — Offer Service, Consumer Platform (~Nov 2023 – Present, 1.5 years):
Building the Offer Service responsible for providing and validating availability across the platform.
Built unified data pipelines for the FE to display room rates and prices, and created standard domain objects for clear data ownership and segregation.
Designing a separate versioned domain structure for availability, pricing, and policy — extendable and version-controlled for the new offer flow.
Working with inventory, availability, pricing, policy, and other data streams to aggregate and share structured data with the FE.
Create and lead unifined data quality tooling for when moving from old flow to the new flow we can maintain data quality.
Helped deliver an AI driven workflow to improve work efficiency and overall productivity for the team.
